name: claude-research
description: Delegate AI-safety research implementation and independent experiment audits from Codex to local Claude Code agents.

interface.shortDescription: Codex plans; local Opus agents implement and audit
interface.longDescription: Use Codex as the research interlocutor while local Claude Code agents implement code, review bugs, audit experiment design and measurement, falsify explanations, and interpret results.
defaultPrompt: Implement this agreed experiment with Opus, then independently audit it
Audit whether this experiment can produce a trustworthy signal
Interpret these results and identify alternative explanations
